messages.content: Hey, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent. What was your blood pressure reading this week?
Logged that, thank you. Did you take your blood pressure medication as usual this week, or were there any days you missed?
Took it every day. No problems.
Perfect, logged that as well. Appreciate you keeping up with it. Your next check-in will come through same time next week — have a good one out there.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
